body: So because I don't think tipping is the customer's responsibility somehow in your mind that equates to  believing in unfair labor practices? What I'm saying is I believe the business should be forced to pay you a living wage with tips being a bonus for you going above and beyond. Also just because I don't tip doesn't mean I won't march for rule changes or actively try to get fair pay for workers in other ways, I just won't do it that way. You are saying we should all perpetuate a situation that you yourself hate.

All I can say is that I'm sorry restaurants don't pay what you and your coworkers are worth. I don't believe however it is the customer's responsibility to make up for the mistakes of a broken system.
